components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button used for high-priority CTA actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C3FF2E; color: #000000; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Information widget container overlaying background mesh gradient orbs.
components.html:
WIDGET HEADLINE

This is some telemetry metrics info shown in a high density container block.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(24px); } .ds-card-title { color: #ffffff; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 10px 0; } .ds-card-text { color: #A3A3A3; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: A high-density cybernetic dark mode layout that emulates a mission control telemetry dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Pitch Black Foundation: Viewports remain rooted in complete dark space to maximize accent contrast.
Fluid Telemetry Orbs: Canvas composites radial blobs in neon lime, purple, and blue drifting dynamically.
Ultra-thin Hairline Accents: Clean structural grid alignments replacing heavy panels.

rules.name: The Contrast Rareness Rule
rules.body: Neon accents are restricted to ≤10% of any given screen area. Accent density conveys interactive priority.

rules.name: The Ambient Rest Rule
rules.body: Glass components remain flat. Hover interactions invoke active borders rather than box-shadow offsets.

dos: Do wrap background canvas layers in absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none to prevent page scroll expansion.
Do use uppercase monospace text for metadata labels and status tags to fit the terminal theme.
donts: Don't use standard box-shadow drops. Depth is strictly defined by opacity layers and backdrop blur.
Don't use solid or bright gray background panels. Keep background blocks translucent to let mesh gradient orbs pass through.
